description: Drive straight 2 m, drive into the door on the LEFT (as straight_2m_then_left_door_direct: no pre-point, approach_dist_m 0.05, the goal is the door centre with its yaw; the nearest STRONG confirmed door on the left when the move starts, picked once; door_not_found after 5 s aborts; entered = 0.15 m along, 0.05 m sideways, 10 deg), then approach the nearest confirmed chair and stop at its default gap. The chair must come into view once through the door: acquire_timeout_sec 10 starts when the third move starts. Needs a door detector (/perception/doors_semantic), semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks) and the global EKF.
